[Story]
Manager Zhang hears that his subordinate Li Ming is considering resigning and joining a competitor. Worried about the leakage of the company's trade secrets, Manager Zhang decides to talk to Li Ming, hoping he stays.

[Question]
How does Manager Zhang persuade Li Ming?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Li, you see, it is the same with competitors, you are better off staying with us.
B. Li, you see you work so hard recently, I talk to the board about giving you a raise, what do you think?
C. Li, we work together for so many years, and I enjoy working with you. You stay for a while longer.
D. Li, are you very tired from work recently? I let Wang share some of your workload, how about you stay first?
